frozen analyze.py reads the C0 fields with .get and checks nofb rows with .get('p0_lines', 0) == 0, so a missing key would pass silently (lesson L-99ee952350b2); it does not check completeness against seeds.json. No effect here: 360 of 360 runs present, the 24 C0 fields and all 86 common keys present and equal on 80 of 80 rows, p0_lines present (0) on all 120 nofb rows

seeds.json: master_seed null; seeded streams on the study path not listed: the descent RNG (0xDEC0_5EED_0000_0001 ^ q ^ seed.rotate_left(17), quartic_ladder.rs run_diem_inner), the sampled factor base (0x5AFB_0000_0000_0000 ^ q and 0x5EED_5AFB_0000_0001 ^ q, sampled_base) and the BSGS order computation (inherited, parent P5). Pairing and arm exclusion are correct and the full replay is byte-identical

section 5a w_cal is not recorded; on the primary panel every pooled interval straddles 1 at w = 0, 0.1 and 1, so the pair is not ranked at any band point and w_cal cannot change the verdict. On the secondary all-seeds panel p0i3/nofb lies below 1 at all three band points (upper 0.837, 0.976, 0.976) and p0/nofb only at w = 0.1 and 1; the protocol assigns that panel no decision and RESULTS.md claims nothing from it

mechanism statements in RESULTS.md 'What this settles' (the P0 lines remove the base-point-shift cause; the unrescued failures fit the frontier-column mechanism) rest on the dev diagnosis and the rescue counts; the grid rows hold no diagnostic. The validator replayed the binary's uncounted diagnosis and core dumps on grid curves (diag.sh, diag_check.json; arms nofb and p0, seeds 1-6; 4099 curve 205, all 16411 curves, 65537 curves 57/156/166/369, 131101 curves 53/177/288). Every p0 attempt core holds a line row not orthogonal to v_deg (89 of 89), so v_deg is never free with the P0 lines (supports the first statement). nofb failed attempts: 24, v_deg free in 18, z columns in 15. p0 failed attempts: 11, all with t undetermined, v_deg free in 0, z columns (columns only in decomposition rows) in 9, and 2 with neither, all of them ab_rank 1 (one or two decomposition rows reach the core): p=4099 curve 205 seed 6 (dec rows 2); p=16411 curve 158 seed 4 (dec rows 1). So the frontier-column reading fits the p0 failures that have z columns, not those with ab_rank 1, which is a third cause the RESULTS text does not name
